items.description: One prospective read-only preflight authorization covering the frozen observation set, exact target and bundle contract, limits, UTC window, stop/retention policy, and disclosed pilot role collapse.
items.resolution_rule: The authorization is read-only, finite, nonretrying, and grants no mutation, calibration, pilot, measurement, or Stage 18 authority.

items.description: Fresh read-only stand preflight and runtime/tool identity output obtained under S17-EXT-001, including explicit archive integration evidence.
items.owner: pilot owner acting as operator and custodian
items.resolution_rule: Incomplete or failed capture remains preserved but unresolved and cannot advance state.

items.description: Single-owner pilot preflight acceptance that recomputes source hashes and disclaims independent audit.
items.resolution_rule: The record states distinct_auditor=false and independent_review_claimed=false.

items.description: Dynamic stand qualification for CPU pairs, clock, atomics/layout, affinity/migration, NUMA/page state, storage, and recovery.
items.resolution_rule: Requested values have separate verified readback; development-host evidence is insufficient.

items.description: Exact privileged-control authorization and evidence for H0/H1, readback, probes, and restoration.
items.resolution_rule: Command success never substitutes for verified state; restoration failure quarantines the stand.

items.description: Clean exact Stage 17 pilot runner release and pilot-candidate archive/sidecar identity.
items.resolution_rule: A metadata-only release claim is insufficient; the exact caller-supplied archive and sidecar must pass the versioned verifier and custody contract.

items.description: Treatment-blind calibration inputs and frozen distance, service-rate, load, and zero-loss-feasibility outputs.
items.resolution_rule: No value is inferred from confirmatory outcomes or a repository default.

items.description: Exact prospective pilot run plan, schedules, seeds, horizons, capacities, and stop rules.
items.owner: protocol, statistical, calibration, and controller owner
items.resolution_rule: The plan contains no confirmatory namespace or outcome access.

items.description: Pilot raw-buffer/durable-storage budget and two-domain custody, transfer, partial-failure, and recovery evidence.
items.resolution_rule: Capacity covers the exact pilot plan; overflow or missing custody remains blocking.

items.description: One exact phase-scoped Stage 17 pilot authorization binding all accepted predecessors and permitted runs.
items.owner: pilot owner acting in the disclosed collapsed roles
items.resolution_rule: It is valid only after S17-EXT-001..009 and cannot authorize Stage 18, top-up, cell repair, hidden retry, or outcome access.
